newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV EXTEND LEAD AS FEYENOORD DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV EXTEND LEAD AS FEYENOORD DRAW.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven extended their lead in the Dutch first division to four points on Sunday when they beat Groningen 1-0,
Second-placed Feyenoord Rotterdam drew 1-1 against Twente Enschede and, with three games left to play, PSV now top the table with 71 points from 31 matches to 67 for Feyenoord from the same number.
In a lacklustre match, PSV defender Stan Valckx scored his first goal of the season with a long distance shot in the 70th minute to move the club a large step nearer their 14th league title.
Feyenoord seemed set to keep the pressure on when defender Henk Fraser scored after 10 minutes with a lob over Twente goalkeeper Sander Boschker.
But two minutes from time Joeri Petrov dented Feyenoord's hopes with a goal from 22 metres.
RKC Waalwijk dropped to last in the league by losing 3-0 to De Graafschap Doetinchem.
Waalwijk have 25 points along with AZ Alkmaar and NEC Nijmegen but have the worst goal difference.
